title: Sentence case: the "Blood Pressure" row and page title, "Waist Circumference" in the grid, and the "Blood Test Results" heading
evidence: Seen in the PR 1508 shots: the row and value-page title say "Blood Pressure" under the "Blood pressure" section; the grid says "Waist Circumference" while the row says "Waist"; the heading "Blood Test Results" is title case. The rest of the UI uses sentence case. (H81)
